objective: Restore `effect census binds transitive closures without duplicating call corpora` to green on the M5 lineage, by deciding which of the two corpora a transitive_function_closure entry is entitled to emit -- and making the writer emit exactly that one.
falsifiable_claim: No entry in effect-census.json carries handler_calls, handler_call_sequence, registration_handler_call_sequence, discovered_handler_calls, or discovered_handler_call_sequence, and check-pre-next-leg passes in full on the M5 lineage.
in_scope: The census writer's emission for handler_resolution == transitive_function_closure, and the six affected M5 event-stream route entries.
out_of_scope: The QM dormant-adoption cut, which inherited this and does not own it.
Any weakening of the test: the assertion is the contract, and deleting it would close the finding by deleting the finder.
positive_proof: node --test scripts/lib/m0-program-control.test.mjs passes in full on the M5 lineage.
node scripts/check-pre-next-leg.mjs exits 0 detached at the M5 tip.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: MEASURED ATTRIBUTION, not inferred. Entries carrying handler_calls: 6 at 4c8f1d794 (M5 cut), 6 at 0c92fa66e, and 0 at the merge-base with master (5e1899e29). The six are all event_stream_routes::handle_* with handler_resolution 'transitive_function_closure' -- the resolution mode the M5 cut introduced.

THE TEST WAS NEVER RUN AT THAT TIP. master's full check-pre-next-leg is green (exit 0), the M5 lineage's is not. The M5 packet was reviewed CLEAN without the full suite being run detached at its own tip, so a red test shipped inside a certified cut. The gate existed; nobody asked it.

Do NOT close this by relaxing the assertion. It forbids CO-PRESENCE of the two call corpora on one entry, and both keys are present on all six: handler_calls/handler_call_sequence at 8/8, 76/166, 96/205, 104/217, 96/245, and 83/191. MEASURED, AND A CORRECTION ON THE RECORD: an earlier version of this line said 'the same 8-element list'. Only ONE entry is 8/8, and even that pair is NOT equal. The first entry was sampled and generalised to six. The assertion never turned on equality -- co-presence is the defect, and the corrected arithmetic makes the case stronger, not weaker, because the two corpora disagree as well as duplicate.
remaining_nonclaims: This record does not decide WHICH corpus is canonical; it requires that exactly one be emitted.
It makes no claim about entries outside the six measured.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Withdraw on loss of selected live adapter evidence.
